in_hebrew.name: אביליו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אביליו הוא שם נדיר המופיע במסורת הנוצרית, ומקורו בשם הלטיני אביליוס, שפירושו אב רחום וחנון, ויש הטוענים כי הוא נגזר מהשורש העברי אב, שפירושו אבא, והוא בעל משמעות רוחנית עמוקה במסורת הנוצרית

in_greek.name: Αβίλιος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αβίλιος είναι μια ελληνική форма του ονόματος Abilio, που προέρχεται από τη λατινική Abilius, και σημαίνει πατέρας εύσπλαχνος, και έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί σε ιστορικό контέκστο ως όνομα αγίων και μαρτύρων της πρώτης χριστιανικής εκκλησίας, και έχει μια πλούσια πνευματική σημασία στην χριστιανική παράδοση

in_latin.name: Abilius
in_latin.long_meaning: Abilius est nomen latinum quod significat patrem benignum, et derivatur a verbo latinum abilis, quod significat forte et potens, et fuit nomen sancti et martiris in ecclesia christiana primitiva, et habet significationem spiritualem profundam in traditione christiana

in_english.name: Abílio
in_english.long_meaning: Abílio is a Christian name derived from the Latin Abilius, meaning father of kindness and mercy, and has its roots in the Hebrew word ab, meaning father, and has been used in historical context as a name of saints and martyrs in the early Christian church, and has a rich spiritual significance in Christian tradition

saint_reference.note: a saint and martyr in the early Christian church

data.cultural_impact: The name Abílio holds deep cultural roots within the Portuguese-speaking communities, particularly in countries such as Brazil and Portugal, where the Portuguese language is prominent. The meanings of the individual components of the name, 'ab' (father) and 'ilio' (joy), reflect the importance placed on the role of the father figure in these societies, as well as the value placed on the expression of joy and happiness.
data.spiritual_significance: Abílio carries a rich spiritual meaning, emphasizing the deep love and joy that a father feels towards his child. In Christian traditions, this name reflects the love and joy that God, as our Heavenly Father, has towards His children. It also serves as a reminder of the father's role to provide joy and happiness in the lives of his children. This name reinforces the idea that happiness and joy come from the love and care of our Heavenly Father and earthly fathers.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Abílio was a 5th century bishop of Braga, Portugal. The name Abílio carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Abílio continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Ruth Abílio in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Abílio, which means "Father's joy". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Abílio means "father's joy" in Portuguese. It is a name given to celebrate the joy and happiness a father experiences upon the birth of his child. Symbolically, it represents the deep love and pride a father has for his offspring. Spiritually, it can be seen as a reminder of God's love and joy in creating each unique individual.
